system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The manager constructs a bounded subtask contractci. A fresh-context executor performs the contract
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are harness-generated per role and per round; `prompt_language` selects en/zh. Exact prompt-building code not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agents work in the directory you launched from, so the task acts on your real project.
env_context_strategy.note: Backend agents (Claude Code/Codex) explore the environment themselves; manager has no environment access.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the executor’s raw interaction trajectory is discarded after each round
context_compaction.note: Cross-round context is replaced by the explicit task state plus audit reports.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The GUI executor receives screen-oriented capabilities such as taking screenshots, clicking, scrolling, and entering text

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: A lightweightAgentAdaptersupports interchangeable model and harness backends without modifying their native agent loops.
tool_call_format.note: Tool-call syntax is delegated to the backend CLI (Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode/dsh); the harness itself invokes backends as subprocesses with a prompt.

tool_count.note: Tool set is whatever the backend CLI plus MCP plugin exposes; no schema list in evidence.

edit_primitive.note: Editing is performed by the backend agent; no edit primitive defined by the harness in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Any MCP server can be passed to the agents, not just computer-use ones. Each backend reads its own native format; nothing is translated between them.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: writes one MCP config per agent under `~/.lh-harness/plugins/`

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Plan → act → verify → checkpoint or recover → repeat — until the work is actually done.
loop_primitives.note: Default MEA loop is plan_execute + verify/repair; backends run their own react loops inside an episode.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The task state is a structured collection of task-relevant records: arequirementrepresents an objective or constraint derived from the original task, anartifactrepresents an output created or modified during execution, and afactrecords environment information

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a manager to maintain the task state and determine the next subtask, a fresh-context executor to perform it, and a read-only auditor to verify the resulting environment state

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the adapter launches an existing backend such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, or OpenClaw as one bounded episode
delegation_mechanism.note: Each round spawns a fresh backend process for the executor/auditor role.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: start a task, pick a backend and model per role, answer approval requests, send an instruction mid-run, stop or restart a run
human_in_loop.note: Dashboard on by default (`dashboard = true`); manager's `ask` route requests user information/authorization; `--no-dashboard` disables.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Each record is marked ascompleted,pending,blocked, oruntrusted, and retains references to the audit evidence supporting its current status.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: `harness_dir` | commented out | Where harness task state is written. Defaults to the run's own `harness/`, keeping it out of the workspace.
long_term_memory.note: Task state persists per run on disk; no cross-run memory shown.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: keep asking follow-up questions after it finishes — a follow-up continues the same run from the rounds it already completed

self_verification.evidence_quote: a read-only auditor to verify the resulting environment state before the next round
self_verification.note: Auditor is a separate model episode; CLI auditor 'uses non-mutating commands and inspection tools to examine files, metadata, logs, processes, tests'.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: a record is marked as completed only when supported by clean audit evidence
retry_policy.note: Rounds repeat until audited state satisfies the task or max_rounds (default 30) is reached.

rollback.evidence_quote: LongHorizon-Harness instead records the failed interaction and the unresolved evidence gaps in the task state.
rollback.note: Recovery is forward-only re-planning from the last audited state; no snapshot/git revert mechanism appears in the evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The loop ends when the audited state satisfies the original task, no permitted subtask can advance the remaining requirements, user input is required, or the round budget is exhausted.
termination_condition.note: max_rounds default 30 in the CLI (25 in paper experiments); `blocked` acts as stall detection.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Each role can take its own `agent`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort`, so you can pay for a strong model only where it matters: a capable Manager and Auditor with a cheaper Executor
cost_controls.note: No token/cost cap field found; budgets are time- and round-based.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Per-episode limits in seconds. One episode is a single role invocation, not the whole run.
timeouts.note: Per-episode (role invocation) timeouts: manager 600, executors 1800, auditor 600; no whole-run timeout.

execution_isolation.note: Backends are launched as local subprocesses (see deepseek_runner.py subprocess.run).

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: uses `workspace-write` for executors, and uses `read-only` for the Manager and auditors

network_policy.evidence_quote: Execution environments | Local, with a pluggable `Environment` protocol
network_policy.note: No network restriction option documented in the configuration reference.

permission_model.evidence_quote: role-scoped read/write permissions, OpenCode API endpoint overrides, normalized JSON results
permission_model.note: Role-scoped read-only/workspace-write permissions passed to the backend; approvals are also surfaced in the Dashboard.

tracing.evidence_quote: Every run is stored under `./.lh-harness/runs/<run-id>/`; the full report, including that reply, stays in the run's `logs/report.json`.

replayability.evidence_quote: the run keeps the partial trajectory and recorded task state, then lets the next Manager round inspect the real workspace and recover
replayability.note: Runs and rounds are recorded and browsable; no replay-of-actions command in evidence.

eval_hooks.note: An `eval/` tree with OSWorld 2.0 (and Terminal-Bench) evaluation ships in the pinned repo.

guardrails.evidence_quote: any detected mutation is recorded as an integrity violation, and the resulting report cannot support a completed task-state record
guardrails.note: Auditor read-only enforcement plus role-scoped permissions.

target_domain.note: GUI desktop plus CLI/coding tasks; MCP servers give general tool use.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: LongHorizon-Harness is not tied to a specific model or agent backend.
